findings.title: California AG SB24 breach listing for Fandango Media, LLC
findings.summary_md: The California Department of Justice SB24 listing records Fandango Media, LLC with a breach date of October 8, 2026 and a reported date of November 13, 2026. The linked filing carries a redacted individual notice template in which Fandango says it became aware of an issue with its ticketing checkout page, investigated with outside cybersecurity specialists, and resolved it. The registry entry predates the first security news coverage by three days.

findings.title: Fandango Media Data Breach Notice: What Happened and Your Legal Options
findings.summary_md: Dapeer Law reported on November 13, 2026 that Fandango had disclosed a data security incident to the Vermont Attorney General. The firm said the filing information then available did not state the number of affected people, the data types, or the incident dates, and it opened an investigation on the same day. This was among the earliest publicly dated write-ups of the notification.

findings.title: Fandango Media Data Breach: Cards Used Oct. 8-11, 2026
findings.summary_md: OpenClassActions reported on November 15, 2026 that card numbers, CVVs, expiration dates, billing ZIP codes and email addresses entered at Fandango's checkout between October 8 and 11 may have been accessed. It noted that Fandango filed the notice with the California Attorney General on November 13 and offered 24 months of IDX monitoring with a February 13, 2027 activation deadline. The site said it had identified no class action over the breach as of November 15.
